edits.after: When a child reaches a position they never reached, adults may feel they have finally proved that their earlier losses were not in vain. This joy can be real, yet place a heavy burden on the child: they must not fail.
edits.reason: Naturalizes impossibility of failure as pressure not to fail, retaining the family's emotional investment rather than factual infallibility.
edits.before: When a child reaches a position they never reached, adults feel they have finally proved that their earlier losses were not in vain. This joy can be real, yet impose a heavy impossibility of failure on the child.

edits.after: Si el hijo alcanza una posición que ellos no alcanzaron, sienten que por fin su pérdida no fue en vano. La alegría puede ser real, pero impone al hijo una carga pesada: no puede permitirse fracasar.
edits.reason: Naturalizes pesada imposibilidad de fracasar as imposed emotional burden, not actual inability to fail.
edits.before: Si alcanza una posición que ellos no alcanzaron, sienten que por fin su pérdida no fue en vano. La alegría puede ser real, pero impone al hijo una pesada imposibilidad de fracasar.

edits.after: The child did not request this arrangement before birth, nor could they negotiate as an equal during their most dependent years. If all basic care is recorded as a debt to be repaid later, the child is treated from the outset as a borrower who had no chance to refuse the loan.
edits.reason: Natural English for begins in a loan without refusal; retains unequal bargaining and retroactive-debt analogy.
edits.before: The child did not request this arrangement before birth, nor could they negotiate as an equal during their most dependent years. If all basic care is entered as a debt to be repaid later, the child begins in a loan they could not refuse.

edits.after: No responde solo por sus elecciones: debe garantizar que el sacrificio de sus padres se convierta en un resultado visible desde fuera.
edits.reason: Disambiguates whose sacrifice the child must convert into a result: parents', not child's.
edits.before: No responde solo por sus elecciones: debe garantizar que su sacrificio se convierta en un resultado visible desde fuera.

edits.after: Quieren que su hijo viva con seguridad y estabilidad, y también que sea alguien a quien puedan comprender. Si valora cosas parecidas y elige una vida que les resulta conocida, sienten que la relación continúa naturalmente.
edits.reason: Vida familiar can mean family-centered life; source means a familiar kind of life recognizable to parents.
edits.before: Quieren seguridad y estabilidad, y también que sea alguien a quien puedan comprender. Si valora cosas parecidas y elige una vida familiar, sienten que la relación continúa naturalmente.

edits.after: «Esto es distinto del futuro que yo imaginaba y necesito adaptarme de nuevo. Pero no te exijo cambiar primero para que podamos seguir relacionándonos».
edits.reason: Synchronizes root's confirmed source pronoun correction: it is the parent's imagined future, not the child's. English owned by root.
edits.before: «Esto es distinto del futuro que tú imaginabas y necesito adaptarme de nuevo. Pero no te exijo cambiar primero para permitir que sigamos relacionándonos».

edits.after: A family may be better understood as a relationship that can withstand its members growing in different directions. They will make new commitments, hold different values, and sometimes be unable to persuade one another about important matters.
edits.reason: Ordinary prose for bearing differentiation; retains new commitments, values and unresolved persuasion.
edits.before: Yet a family may better be understood as a relationship capable of bearing differentiation. Members acquire new commitments and different values, and may be unable to persuade one another on important matters.

edits.after: Por supuesto, los padres no tienen por qué disculparse por cada malestar de su hijo.
edits.reason: 不必 is no obligation, not a blanket prohibition on apologizing for unhappiness.
edits.before: Por supuesto, los padres no deben disculparse por todo malestar del hijo.

edits.after: It means moving from living the child's life for them to maintaining a relationship with a different person.
edits.reason: 替孩子生活 means on the child's behalf, not simply having devotion to the child as one's purpose.
edits.before: It means moving from living for the child to maintaining a relationship with a different person.

edits.after: Es pasar de vivir la vida del hijo en su lugar a relacionarse con una persona distinta.
edits.reason: Clarifies vivir por el hijo as living on their behalf, not merely living for their sake.
edits.before: Es pasar de vivir por el hijo a relacionarse con una persona distinta.

edits.after: Como si madurar significara no escuchar consejos, no necesitar ayuda y no depender de ninguna relación. Nadie vive así. Los adultos consultan, confían asuntos a otros y recurren al juicio ajeno ante las dificultades.
edits.reason: Makes negation apply unambiguously to each item; preserves consultation, entrusting and borrowed judgment.
edits.before: Como si madurar fuera no escuchar consejos, necesitar ayuda ni depender de relaciones. Nadie vive así. Los adultos consultan, confían asuntos a otros y recurren a su juicio ante dificultades.

edits.after: When parents stop deciding for their children, they also have to stop claiming the final say over who their children really are.
edits.reason: Naturalizes interpret their selves for them while preserving the limit on authoritative self-definition, as57 clarifies.
edits.before: Ceasing to decide for children also means ceasing to interpret their selves for them.
